caption: The drawing depicts a vertical column standing on a rectangular base. The column is primarily colored with alternating diagonal stripes of red and white, separated by horizontal bands at intervals. The base is square and decorated with triangular sections of red and white, converging at a circular, golden ornamental feature at the center of each face. The corners of the base are accented with rounded, gold-colored embellishments. At the top of the column, there is a spherical golden object, and above it is a small, dark bird-like figure with outstretched wings. The overall palette of the drawing includes red, white, gold, black, and some gray tones, with the background left a plain, light beige color.
title: Barber Pole
